current.thesis: One active manuscript at thesis.md in staging. §§8.4, 8.8 and 10.2 analyse adversarial discovery, cross-profile event evidence and set-level atomicity. The Pigeonhole specification claims reader-side AllOrNothing atomicity, but pinned v0.0.90 source inspection shows sequential destination writes, independent persistence and no rollback of a successful prefix in the inspected failure path; actual reader visibility remains untested. Pinned katzenqt 0.0.2 separately stores received pieces and only dispatches a complete contiguous chain to its conversation log; this is app-level gating, not AllOrNothing or atomic storage, and the client is pre-alpha/not suitable to rely on for privacy. No defect, deployed advantage or novelty is established.

thesis_argument.central_question: How can endpoint-controlled messaging preserve authenticated message semantics across replaceable, untrusted carriage routes, including image carriage, and what can route-specific evidence establish under defined observer models?
thesis_argument.proposition: Transport independence requires authenticated message semantics to remain under endpoint control across route-specific encapsulation and delivery, with explicit observer evidence.
thesis_argument.route_synthesis: Image studies inform media transformation; Dropbox direct-invitation and view-only-link paths differ; Signal specifications and public Android/iOS/Desktop release tags do not pin backend/account behaviour; Katzenpost has compatible v0.0.90 / thin_client 0.0.23 / katzenqt 0.0.2 source pins, not a deployed configuration. Pigeonhole AllOrNothing specification claims are in tension with the inspected sequential-write/no-rollback source path; katzenqt uses a separate app-level complete-chain gate. Reader-visible behaviour remains untested; no measured route advantage or novelty is established.
thesis_argument.prior_art_pressure: Thesis explicitly confronts OMR/GOMR and PerfOMR/SophOMR/InstantOMR, Oblivious Signaling, Remise, dead-drop covert messaging and image-diffusion covert communication. Generic private-discovery, whole-pipeline and image-covert-channel novelty claims are not supportable.
thesis_argument.limits: No deployed route comparison, implementation, experiment, formal proof, independent review or audit.

current.discovery_model: Discovery is decomposed into bootstrap/trust establishment, publication/indexing, candidate enumeration, recipient pertinence/retrieval authorisation, retrieval, extraction, endpoint validation and conversation association. Seven adversarial cases are integrated: bootstrap substitution, malicious publication, index equivocation/suppression, retrieval manipulation, cross-role collusion, retention/later disclosure and suppression/delay ambiguity. Endpoint-authenticated facts, service-reported events, observed metadata and inferred correlations remain distinct; index response does not prove completeness, and silence does not identify why a carrier is absent. No discovery mechanism, index-consistency mechanism or deletion guarantee is selected.
current.route_synthesis: Image studies inform media transformation; Dropbox documents owner/editor file activity and conditional viewer information; Signal specifications inform protocol mechanics but not the full service; Echomix/Pigeonhole is the strongest integrated comparator, with AllOrNothing atomic set semantics and explicit replica/retention constraints. Set-level atomicity/partial visibility is now a comparison dimension; the current matrix is descriptive, not a measured result.
current.set_level_atomicity: Pigeonhole specification claims reader-side AllOrNothing atomicity; pinned v0.0.90 source shows sequential destination-envelope dispatch, independent persistence and no rollback of a successful prefix on the inspected failure path. Reader visibility is untested. katzenqt 0.0.2 separately persists received pieces and gates conversation-log dispatch on a terminal F plus contiguous decodable chain; this is application-level gating, not AllOrNothing or atomic storage. No code/tests executed.

invariants: Image carriage is a required research comparison, not a mandatory runtime route.
Orchestration is optional; analyse service roles separately.
Protected object remains invariant unless explicit authenticated conversion is defined.
Package encapsulation is not endpoint authentication.
Endpoint-authenticated linkage and observer-inferred linkage are distinct.
Per-image concealment does not establish collection-level concealment.
GIF frames within one carrier are not separate image posts or logical messages.
Majority voting over bit errors does not establish missing-frame erasure tolerance.
No anonymity/security inference from carrier uniqueness, concealment or extra hops.
Preserve dissent, provenance, uncertainty and historical work; distinguish proposals from demonstrated properties.
Confidence is claim-specific, verifier-relative, evidence-bounded and time-sensitive; it is not a cryptographic property or semantic truth.
A valid fragment does not establish set completeness; a complete set does not establish conversation continuity.
Transport acceptance is not endpoint receipt, decryption, display, human reading or comprehension.
Prefer endpoint-local evidence and minimum necessary disclosure; no central confidence ledger or universal score by default.
